keyDecisions: Old approach: fetch ALL survey_units in city (100K rows, capped at 1000 by PostgREST) → items by PSID (URL exceeded 300 limit). List showed/hid on every poll.

total_items from daily_assignments replaces the expensive totalByAssignment query on assignment_items.
keepPreviousData prevents the list from wiping clean on every poll refetch.
selectedCity added to offset reset dependency so switching cities resets the feed.
